speak: Corporation's name.
Business number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year-end. Date. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Line 025. Active business income minus active business losses of your corporation for the year. Line 100 or line 120, whichever applies, of Schedule 27, if filed.
Line 030. Adjusted Crown royalties for the tax year. Amount 5H in Part 5.
Amount 1A. Subtotal. Line 025 plus line 030.
Line 040. Notional resource allowance for the tax year as determined in subsection 7(3) of Ontario Regulation 37/09 under the Taxation Act, 2007, Ontario.
Line 050. Adjusted business income. Amount 1A minus line 040. If negative, enter 0.
Amount 2A. Canadian manufacturing and processing profits. Line 200 of Schedule 27.
Amount 2B. Canadian profits from generating electrical energy or producing steam for sale. Line 210 of Schedule 27 minus amount 2A.
Amount 2C. Total Canadian farming, fishing, or logging income. Line 150 in Part 3.
Amount 2D. Total Canadian mining income. Amount 4A in Part 4.
Line 075. Total Eligible Canadian profits. Total of amounts 2A, 2B, 2C, and 2D.
Amount 2E. Ontario adjusted small business income. Amount 3A in Part 3 of Schedule 500, Ontario Corporation Tax Calculation.
Amount 2F. Excess. Line 075 minus amount 2E, if negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount 2F. Instance 2.
Amount 2G. Adjusted taxable income. Line 360 of the T2 return plus line 030, minus line 040.
Amount 2H. Ontario adjusted small business income. Amount 2E.
Factor. 1 minus the result of taxable income earned in all provinces and territories divided by total taxable income.
Amount 2I. Amount 2G multiplied by Factor.
Amount 2J. Aggregate investment income. Line 440 of the T2 Return.
Amount 2K. Subtotal. Total of amounts 2H, 2I, and 2J. Instance 1.
Amount 2K. Instance 2.
Amount 2L. Excess. Amount 2G minus amount 2K. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount 2L. Instance 2.
Amount 2M. Income eligible for the Ontario tax credit for manufacturing and processing. Least of amounts, line 050 in Part 1, amount 2F, or amount 2L. Instance 1.
Amount 2M. Instance 2.
Taxable income for Ontario.
Taxable income for all provinces and territories.

Amount 2N. Ontario tax credit for manufacturing and processing. Amount 2M multiplied by the result of taxable income for Ontario divided by taxable income for all provinces and territories, multiplied by 1.5%.

Line 100. Adjusted business income. Enter the amount from line 130 in Part 3 of Schedule 27, if filed. If Schedule 27 has not been filed, see Part 3 of that schedule to calculate the adjusted business income.

Line 120. Cost of manufacturing and processing capital. See Part 5 of Schedule 27 to calculate the cost of manufacturing and processing capital for farming, fishing, logging, or industrial mining operations.

Line 140. Cost of manufacturing and processing labour. See Part 7 of Schedule 27 to calculate the cost of manufacturing and processing labour for farming, fishing, logging, or industrial mining operations.

Line 110. Cost of capital. See Part 4 of Schedule 27 to calculate the cost of capital for farming, fishing, logging, or industrial mining operations. For a farming operation, the cost of capital includes the cost of land, and/or the annual rental cost of the land, used by the corporation for its farming business.
Line 130. Cost of labour. See Part 6 of Schedule 27 to calculate the cost of labour for farming, fishing, logging, or industrial mining operations.
Line 150. Line 100 multiplied by, total of lines 120 and 140 divided by total of lines 110 and 130.
Line 175. Mining profits under subparagraph 2(i) of subsection 33(7) of the Taxation Act, 2007 Ontario.

Line 200. Adjusted business income. Enter the amount from line 130 in Part 3 of Schedule 27, if filed. If Schedule 27 has not been filed, see Part 3 of that schedule to calculate the adjusted business income.

Line 220. Cost of manufacturing and processing capital. See Part 5 of Schedule 27 to calculate the cost of manufacturing and processing capital for farming, fishing, logging, or industrial mining operations.

Line 240. Cost of manufacturing and processing labour. See Part 7 of Schedule 27 to calculate the cost of manufacturing and processing labour for farming, fishing, logging, or industrial mining operations.

Line 210. Cost of capital. See Part 4 of Schedule 27 to calculate the cost of capital for farming, fishing, logging, or industrial mining operations. For a farming operation, the cost of capital includes the cost of land, and/or the annual rental cost of the land, used by the corporation for its farming business.
Line 230. Cost of labour. See Part 6 of Schedule 27 to calculate the cost of labour for farming, fishing, logging, or industrial mining operations.
Line 250. Line 200 multiplied by, total of lines 220 and 240 divided by total of lines 210 and 230.
Amount 4A. Total Canadian mining income. Line 175 plus line 250.

Amount 5A. Provincial or territorial tax on income from mining operations, excluding amounts prescribed in subsection 108.1(2) of Ontario Regulation 183, as it applies under subsection 11.0.1(2) of the Corporations Tax Act, Ontario.
Amount 5B. A Crown charge, paid or payable to the Crown, or receivable by the Crown under subsections 11.0.1(3) or (5) of the Corporations Tax Act, Ontario.

Amount 5C. Adjustment to income where an operator, at any time in a tax year, disposes of or acquires production from a Canadian natural accumulation of petroleum or natural gas, an oil or gas well, or a mineral resource at less than or more than the fair market value under subsection 26(4.1) of the Corporations Tax Act, Ontario.
Amount 5D. Payments made under contract to reimburse Crown charges under paragraph 1 of subsection 26(7) of the Corporations Tax Act, Ontario.

Amount 5E. The corporation's share of amounts 5A and 5B incurred by a partnership of which the corporation is a majority interest partner under subsection 31(1.2) of the Corporations Tax Act, Ontario.
Amount 5F. Subtotal. Total of amounts 5A to 5E.
Amount 5G. Amounts received under contract as reimbursements of Crown charges under paragraph 2 of subsection 26(7) of the Corporations Tax Act, Ontario.
Amount 5H. Adjusted Crown royalties for the tax year. Amount 5F minus amount 5G. Enter amount 5H at line 030 in Part 1.
